cohort.selection: sha256(r05:subset: + split + : + CVE), within frozen R04 splits

budget: All 30 epochs run, with no early stopping; identical update counts across decay conditions
selection: Earliest strictly lowest validation MAE among epochs 1 through 30; epoch zero ineligible
gain: Reuse frozen R04 gain derived only from the 1023 training input histories
primary_comparison: Within model and seed: zero_decay validation MAE minus original_decay validation MAE
limitations: Outcome-independent subsets of the existing development cohort, not a new independent validation set
Current descriptions are retrospective and not authenticated historical Day-30 text
Gradient ratios motivated this experiment but do not establish causality
Small-cohort validation results are exploratory, not final model selection evidence
The scalar reference fits median training residuals for MAE, not the neural Smooth L1 objective
Selected checkpoints may be from different epochs despite equal total training budgets
